topic: Interior Lighting Sub System (Z-ONE-3.0 Platform-SSTS-IBD10) - Sub System Technical Specification
row_semantics: Each row represents a specific command or configuration parameter for the interior lighting system, including breathing modes, fade speed commands, on/off requests, and color commands.

column_semantics.Input: The signal or command input to the system.

core_entities.name: CnsoRHBLampFadeSpdCmd_1
core_entities.description: Command for setting the fade speed of the right-hand breathing lamp.

core_entities.name: CnsoRHCLampOnOff_1
core_entities.description: Command for turning the right-hand central lamp on or off.

core_entities.name: CnsoRHCLampColorCmd_1
core_entities.description: Command for setting the color of the right-hand central lamp.

core_entities.name: LHZCU
core_entities.description: Lighting and Hazard Control Unit, responsible for managing lighting functions.

core_entities.name: CnsoAmbtLampB_RH
core_entities.description: Signal representing the brightness level of the center ambient lamp on the right/horizontal side.

core_conditions.name: Rate
core_conditions.description: Defines the breathing cycle rate in seconds, ranging from 1s to 12s, corresponding to different breathing modes.

core_conditions.name: 指令值
core_conditions.description: Command value indicating the action to be performed; 0 means stop breathing, and other values trigger specific breathing modes.

core_conditions.name: Spd
core_conditions.description: Fade speed settings for transitioning between states, with default and reserved speeds.

core_outputs.name: 灯头闪烁
core_outputs.description: The headlight performs periodic flashing according to the breathing cycle command.

core_outputs.name: 颜色/亮度切换
core_outputs.description: Transition time for changing the lamp's color or brightness from current to target state.

core_outputs.name: 点亮ON
core_outputs.description: When turning ON, the lamp requires a non-zero color/brightness command.

core_timing_constraints.name: Breathing Cycle
core_timing_constraints.description: Defined by 'Rate' values from 1s to 12s, each corresponding to a specific breathing mode.

core_timing_constraints.name: Fade Speed
core_timing_constraints.description: Default speed is 2000ms; Spd2 is 100ms (reserved for future use); Spd3 is reserved.

engineering_interpretation: This table defines the technical specifications for controlling the interior lighting system's breathing modes, fade speeds, on/off states, and color commands. It is used to verify that the system correctly interprets commands, applies the correct timing constraints, and transitions between states as expected.
